step1_analysis.circuit_type: Cross-coupled charge pump stage (Pelliconi charge pump)
step1_analysis.description: A power-efficient charge pump stage that uses cross-coupled NMOS and PMOS transistors to transfer charge from a lower voltage to a higher voltage without threshold voltage drops. It is driven by two out-of-phase clocks coupled through capacitors.

paper_reference.title: Power Efficient Charge Pump in Deep Submicron Standard CMOS Technology

v_out_avg.description: Steady-state average output voltage at VHIGH.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_out = VLOW + VDD - I_load/(f_clk*C_pump) - V_loss. With VLOW=1.8V, VDD=1.8V, I_load~66uA, f=100MHz, C=5pF: V_out ≈ 3.6V - 0.13V - 0.17V = 3.3V
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single stage adds approximately VDD to the input voltage, minus load-dependent ripple and parasitic switching losses.

efficiency.description: Power efficiency, defined as the ratio of power delivered to the load versus total power drawn from the DC supply and clock sources.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported efficiency. The cross-coupled structure eliminates Vth drops, leading to high efficiency, limited mainly by parasitic bottom-plate capacitance and dynamic switching power.

v_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage variation at the output in steady state.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ripple is inversely proportional to the load capacitance and clock frequency, and directly proportional to the load current.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the steady-state output voltage, voltage ripple, and power efficiency of the charge pump stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pelliconi Charge Pump Stage Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm0=5u L_xm0=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

.param C_pump=5p
.param C_load=10p
.param R_load=50000
.param f_clk=100Meg
.param t_per={1/f_clk}
.param t_pw={t_per/2 - 0.1n}

* DUT
XM0 N_TOP N_BOT VLOW VLOW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm0} w={W_xm0}
XM1 N_BOT N_TOP VLOW VLOW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N_TOP N_BOT VHIGH VHIGH sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N_BOT N_TOP VHIGH VHIGH sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Voltage Sources
V_VLOW VLOW 0 1.8
V_CLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 0.1n 0.1n {t_pw} {t_per})
V_CLKB CLKB 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 0.1n 0.1n {t_pw} {t_per})

* Pumping Capacitors
C1 CLK N_TOP {C_pump}
C2 CLKB N_BOT {C_pump}

* Load Network
C3 VHIGH 0 {C_load}
R1 VHIGH 0 {R_load}

* Power Measurement B-Sources
B_pin PIN_NODE 0 V = -i(V_VLOW)*v(VLOW) - i(V_CLK)*v(CLK) - i(V_CLKB)*v(CLKB)
B_pout POUT_NODE 0 V = v(VHIGH)*v(VHIGH)/50000

* Initial Conditions to speed up steady-state convergence
.ic v(VHIGH)=1.8 v(N_TOP)=1.8 v(N_BOT)=1.8

.control
tran 1n 3u

* Measure Output Voltage and Ripple
meas tran v_out_avg avg v(VHIGH) from=2.5u to=3.0u
meas tran v_out_max max v(VHIGH) from=2.5u to=3.0u
meas tran v_out_min min v(VHIGH) from=2.5u to=3.0u
let v_ripple = v_out_max - v_out_min
print v_out_avg
print v_ripple

* Measure Power and Efficiency
meas tran p_in_avg avg v(PIN_NODE) from=2.5u to=3.0u
meas tran p_out_avg avg v(POUT_NODE) from=2.5u to=3.0u
let efficiency = p_out_avg / p_in_avg * 100
print efficiency

quit
.endc
.end
